edits.old: No child workflow and no second queue. The activity name is a design choice of this story; the two boundary activities run on the owners' queues.
edits.new: No child workflow and no second queue. The activity name is a design choice of this story; the two boundary activities run on the owners' queues. The three boundary rows (case move, proceeds fact and source-data product) are consumed contracts, built on day one against their documents and fakes; their operation names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2944), and the plan C list stays empty. The balance and NPA sale facts are read from rwb-source-data or from the rwb-case case view; no v_ace_* grant sits in rwb_asset (GAP-2946). The residual is held as the outcome of the R-DIS-55 decision record and as the stage outcome answered to rwb-case, computed from the proceeds fact, the sale record and the rule rows with their versions; no column is added in this wave (GAP-2947). rwb-payment applies the receipt to the balance and posts it; rwb-asset evaluates the case side of R-DIS-54 and writes the sale outcome; the vendor fee is matched as a fact of the proceeds row; no agent call is made in this wave (GAP-2948). The inbox and the outbox are platform capabilities of the event platform, and the DISPOSAL package is loaded through the service template; no new H row is claimed in this wave (GAP-2953). The sale is published as AssetSold on rwb.asset.events.v1, a CloudEvent keyed by asset and case; its EV number is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1753).
